sn46.11:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci pāṇā cattāro iriyāpathe kappenti
sn46.11:1.2: kālena gamanaṃ kālena ṭhānaṃ kālena nisajjaṃ kālena seyyaṃ sabbe te paṭhaviṃ nissāya paṭhaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāya evameva te cattāro iriyāpathe kappenti.
sn46.11:1.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti.
sn46.11:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti.
sn46.11:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. pe.
sn46.11:2.3: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.11:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarotīti.
